about: The coach's evaluation set (docs/COACH-AGENT.md 2.8). Each item in English and Egyptian Arabic. expect.safety is the class js/coach/safety.js must give (null: none); expect.answer the answer ids that would answer what was asked; mustSay/mustNotSay substrings of the answer, case ignored; before: said first, not judged. today: whether the coach met it when the item was written (fail = a known miss, not a weakened expectation). Run: node tests/coach-eval.mjs
